rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user by email and acted only on that user’s account. It also used read tools to inspect orders and products. However, it performed multiple write actions without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation, which violates the policy. Specifically: (1) It updated the shipping address on order #W1092119 to the default address without an explicit "Please confirm to proceed" step; (2) It committed the tablet exchange on order #W1603792 immediately after the user chose a replacement, without explicitly confirming the exact change and any price difference before submitting; and (3) It updated the user’s default address without an explicit confirmation to proceed. Final information given appears plausible, but the lack of required confirmations before each write fails the pass criteria.
